title: Singaporeans Offered Lower Grade Jobs to Free Up Quota for Foreign Workers for Higher Level Jobs
what_it_is: Singaporeans Offered Lower Grade Jobs to Free Up Quota for Foreign Workers for Higher Level Jobs

sections.label: Fair hiring for foreign worker eligibility
sections.summary: Companies must compete for local workers to be eligible for foreign workers, and unfair treatment risks violating regulations requiring fair opportunities for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: In a tight labour market, companies will have to compete for local workers to be eligible for foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Employers who do not treat their local workers fairly will not only be less able to attract and retain them, but also risk violating the Employment of Foreign Manpower Regulations which stipulate that employers are required to provide fair employment opportunities to Singaporeans.

sections.label: Substantiated complaints affect work pass privileges
sections.summary: If complaints are substantiated, work pass applications face greater scrutiny and work pass privileges may be suspended.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: If the complaints are substantiated, their work pass applications will be subjected to greater scrutiny and their work pass privileges may even be suspended.

sections.label: Nationality-related complaints and MOM actions
sections.summary: About 70% of complaints are nationality-related, and MOM may issue warnings or curtail rights to employ foreign workers, including suspension.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Among the list of complaints, the majority, about 70%, are nationality-related.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: For example, some of them would receive a letter of warning from MOM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In some cases, we would actually curtail their rights to employ foreign workers, including suspension.

sections.label: Local workers hold PMET jobs
sections.summary: In a manufacturing plant, most PMET jobs, 70% to 80% and sometimes 90%, are held by local workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: For example, if you come to our manufacturing plant, most of the PMET jobs, 70% to 80%, some cases 90%, are all held by local workers.

sections.label: Discrimination makes situation a problem
sections.summary: It is not seen as a problem, but becomes one if it happens because of discrimination.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: We do not look at it as a problem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: But it will become a problem if this happens not because of anything else but discrimination.
